cases.name: phase 0: a leading Cyrillic capital A in an English heading is repaired
phase 0: a Cyrillic capital A inside a screaming-snake-case constant is repaired
a Greek capital alpha inside a Latin word is repaired
a Cyrillic small o inside a Latin word is repaired (the private-window marker)
a Cyrillic small o inside a host is repaired (the excluded-site host)
a wholly-twin word beside an English word is left alone
all-caps Cyrillic beside English survives (the corruption an earlier rule caused)
a real Russian sentence is untouched
a real Greek word is untouched
a real Greek sentence is untouched
tabs, double spaces and a no-break space are preserved exactly
newlines separate words, so a whole multi-line read behaves like one line at a time
U+0085 NEXT LINE is whitespace, so the Cyrillic word beside English survives
U+FEFF is not whitespace, so it does not split a word the reader keeps whole
a word of digits and underscores has no Latin letter, so its twin stays
an already-repaired string is returned unchanged
